Class SdCard

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io.storage.SdCard
public final class SdCard extends Object
Access to an SPI SD card, backed by the Arduino SdFat library with long-file-name support enabled.

Call begin() for the standard D10 chip-select pin, or begin(int) for custom wiring, before opening or appending to files. Every path must currently be a compile-time string literal and use the SD card's root as its base. open(String) is read-only; append(String, String) is the only way to write, and always opens, writes one line, and closes the file again rather than keeping a writable handle open.
